name: piloxa
description: Piloxa's own catalogue: the Piloxa plugin, which turns a letter or a document into real USPS Certified Mail after a person reviews and authorizes it.

plugins.name: piloxa
plugins.description: Send a letter or a document you already have as real USPS Certified Mail. Claude prepares the mailing and returns a review link; a person checks the pages, the recipient and the total, then pays and authorizes. Nothing is mailed or charged from inside the conversation.
